theme_central: Allah's cosmic law: humbling the arrogant (Pharaoh, Qarun) and ultimately raising up the oppressed — consolation for the Prophet and the persecuted believers.

branches.title: Opening, Pharaoh the oppressor
branches.resume: Pharaoh oppresses the Children of Israel; Allah wants to favor the oppressed and make them leaders.

children.t: Pharaoh oppresses the Children of Israel, Allah wants to favor the oppressed

branches.title: Musa as a child, exile, Madyan
branches.resume: Saved from the waters and returned to his mother, kills a man by accident and flees, arrives at Madyan.

children.t: Baby Musa saved from the waters, returned to his mother through a stratagem
Musa kills a man by accident, flees the city
Arrival at Madyan, help given to the two women, marriage, years as a shepherd

branches.title: The burning bush, the mission
branches.resume: Call at Mount Sinai, mission entrusted along with Harun, revelation compared to that of Musa.

children.t: The burning bush, the mission, asking for Harun's help
Confrontation with Pharaoh summarized, revelation addressed to the Prophet as to Musa

branches.title: Confrontation with the Quraysh
branches.resume: Contradictions of the Quraysh exposed, guidance belongs to Allah alone.

children.t: Contradictions of the Quraysh exposed, People of the Book who believe in the Qur'an
Guidance belongs to Allah alone, fate of whoever follows his own desires

branches.title: Qarun
branches.resume: Qarun's wealth and arrogance, swallowed up by the earth as punishment.

children.t: Qarun's arrogance over his wealth, swallowed up by the earth

branches.title: Closing
branches.resume: The final abode reserved for whoever seeks neither pride nor corruption on earth.

children.t: The final abode for whoever seeks neither pride nor corruption
